articles.summary: "Holiday shopping is already a major expense for families, and this year, the cost of getting home to celebrate is adding even more pressure," said Mackenzie Shand, Shopping Expert and Executive Editor at RetailMeNot. "At RetailMeNot, we've spent 20 years helping people make their money go further. This National Cash Back Day, we're not only bringing shoppers some of the biggest cash back opportunities of the season, but also giving them the chance to turn their holiday shopping into a trip home. It's all about helping shoppers get more out of every dollar they spend." The post RetailMeNot Kicks Off Its 20th Holiday Season With Annual Cash Back Day Event, Live Now Across 3,500+ Retailers and This Year, Your Shopping Could Send You Home for the Holidays appeared first on Ziff Davis .
articles.title: RetailMeNot Kicks Off Its 20th Holiday Season With Annual Cash Back Day Event, Live Now Across 3,500+ Retailers and This Year, Your Shopping Could Send You Home for the Holidays

articles.summary: Ziff Davis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZD) (“Ziff Davis” or “the Company”) today reported unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We delivered third quarter results in line with the expectations we set last quarter, including sequential revenue growth despite a challenging operating environment,” said Vivek Shah, CEO of Ziff Davis. “Through the first three quarters of 2026, we repurchased approximately $265 million of our shares, reducing our share count by nearly 14%, and we will keep pursuing opportunities to unlock additional shareholder value.” THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS Revenues (1) decreased to $289.3 million compared to $306.5 million for Q3 2025. Operating (loss) income decreased to an operating loss of $(33.6) million compared to operating income of $11.4 million for Q3 2025. This includes a $29.6 million goodwill impairment recognized in Q3 2026 compared to $17.6 million in Q3 2025 and a $14.6 million long-lived assets impairment recognized in Q3 2026
articles.title: Ziff Davis Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
